title: MythicWeaponsUltimate
description: Adds 6 Mythic Weapons in Minecraft! With Custom Abilities, Textures and much more!
body:
# 🔮 MythicWeapons Ultimate
## ⚡ The Ultimate Custom Weapons Experience for PaperMC 1.21+
## 🕒 Short Description (Quick & Easy Overview)
MythicWeapons Ultimate is a custom weapon plugin for Minecraft servers. It adds 6 legendary weapons to your game. Each weapon has its own custom 3D look, helpful passive perks, and powerful special abilities.

**Easy Crafting:** Players can craft every weapon directly in a normal survival crafting table.

**Custom Textures:** Every weapon uses unique textures (CustomModelData), so they look completely different from standard Minecraft items.

**No Lag:** Built to run smoothly, even on big servers with lots of players.

**100% Safe:** Players cannot cheat or fake these items using anvils.

## 📜 Long Description (Full Guide & Every Feature)
MythicWeapons Ultimate makes combat on your server much more exciting. It is perfect for survival, RPG, or PvP servers. Here is exactly how every weapon works, how to craft them, and how they look!

## 🗡️ The Mythic Weapon Arsenal
### 🩸 Blood Blade
A powerful sword for players who love to go on the attack.

**How it looks:** A custom, blood-red blade texture.

**Passive Perk:** Gives you permanent Strength while you hold the sword in your hand.

**Active Ability (Blood Throw):** Right-click to throw your sword forward. It flies through the air, pierces through multiple enemies in a straight line, and deals exactly 5 hearts of damage to everyone it hits.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Spieder Eye | 1x Emerald Block | 1x Spider Eye

Middle Row: 1x Golden Apple | 1x Netherite Sword | 1x Golden Apple

Bottom Row: 1x Spider Eye | 1x Golden Apple | 1x Spider Eye

### 🪓 Titanium Axe
A heavy axe made for fast combat and crowd control.

**How it looks:** A heavy, futuristic titanium axe texture.

**Passive Perk:** Gives you Haste V. This makes your axe swing incredibly fast for fluid combat.

**Active Ability (Ground Smash):** Right-click to smash the ground. It creates a big shockwave that knocks back nearby enemies. The particles automatically match the blocks you are standing on (like grass, sand, or stone), but it will not destroy any blocks on your map.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Iron Block | 1x Gray Candle | 1x Iron Block

Middle Row: 1x Feather | 1x Netherite Axe | 1x Feather~~~~

Bottom Row: 1x Iron Block | 1x Feather | 1x Iron Block

### 🏹 Frozen Crossbow
The ultimate weapon for keeping your distance and slowing down fast enemies.

**How it looks:** A frost-covered crossbow with custom loading and shooting animations.

**Passive Perk:** Any normal arrow you shoot will apply a Slowness effect to the target.

**Active Ability (Arrow Rain):** Right-click to shoot a massive burst of ice arrows into the sky. When they land, they freeze and slow down entire groups of enemies at once.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Packed Ice | 1x Ominous Trial Key | 1x Packed Ice

Middle Row: 1x Gold Block | 1x Crossbow | 1x Gold Block

Bottom Row: 1x Packed Ice | 1x Gold Block | 1x Packed Ice

### 🔱 Void Trident
A legendary weapon for stealth, underwater movement, and teleportation.

**How it looks:** A dark, glowing purple trident from the void.

**Passive Perk:** Gives you permanent Dolphin's Grace and Water Breathing while holding it.

**Active Ability 1 (Void Cloak):** Shift + Right-click to become completely invisible to all other players for 10 seconds. It has a built-in safety system: if you log out while invisible, you will become visible again automatically so you don't get bugged.

**Active Ability 2 (Void Rift):** Right-click to instantly teleport up to 50 blocks in the direction you are looking. It features an anti-glitch system that prevents you from getting stuck inside walls.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Echo Shard | 1x Heart of the Sea | 1x Echo Shard

Middle Row: 1x Ender Pearl | 1x Trident | 1x Ender Pearl

Bottom Row: 1x Echo Shard | 1x Glowstone Dust | 1x Echo Shard

### ☄️ Inferno Mace
An explosive weapon made to complement the standard Minecraft mace mechanics.

**How it looks:** A fiery, heavy nether-themed mace.

**Passive Perk:** You take zero fall damage, allowing you to jump from any height to land epic mace attacks.

**Active Ability 1 (Inferno Pull):** Right-click an enemy from up to 30 blocks away to pull them through the air directly to your feet.

**Active Ability 2 (Hell Boost):** Shift + Right-click to create a fire explosion at your feet that launches you high up into the air. This is optimized so it won't trigger anti-cheat plugins.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Blaze Rod | 1x Nether Star | 1x Blaze Rod

Middle Row: 1x Diamond Block | 1x Mace | 1x Diamond Block

Bottom Row: 1x Blaze Rod | 1x Diamond Block | 1x Blaze Rod

### ⚡ Storm Shield
The ultimate defensive tool to protect yourself and turn enemy attacks against them.

**How it looks:** A large electric shield with custom blocking textures.

**Passive Perk:** Gives you permanent Resistance II when held in either your main hand or your offhand.

**Active Ability 1 (Divine Protection):** Shift + Right-click to become completely immune to all damage for 5 seconds. This effect safely stops if you leave the server, preventing godmode glitches.

**Active Ability 2 (Damage Reflect):** Right-click right before getting hit to absorb the enemy's attack and reflect 100% of the damage back at them.

**Crafting Recipe:**

Top Row: 1x Experience Bottle | 1x Netherite Ingot | 1x Experience Bottle

Middle Row: 1x Firework Star | 1x Shield | 1x Firework Star

Bottom Row: 1x Experience Bottle | 1x Firework Star | 1x Experience Bottle

### ⏳ Simple Cooldown System
To keep gameplay fair, players cannot spam the special abilities.

**Action Bar Timer:** When an ability is used, a clean timer appears right above the player's hotbar (for example, §c4.5s).

**Ready Message:** When the cooldown finishes, it clearly displays §aReady!.

**No Server Lag:** Cooldowns are instantly cleared from the server memory when they run out, keeping the server fast.

### 🛡️ Anti-Cheat & Exploit Protection
**Anvil Safe:** The plugin does not check the name of the item. It checks a hidden server-side number (CustomModelData 1001 to 1006). If a player renames a normal diamond sword to "Blood Blade" in an anvil, it will just be a normal diamond sword. They cannot cheat the system.

### 🔧 Commands & Setup
**Compatibility:** Works perfectly on PaperMC 1.21+ and uses Java 21+.

**Admin Command:** Admins can easily give items to players using:

/giveweapon <player> <weapon>

Permission needed: mythicweapons.command.give
